prompt: Create a photorealistic hosted Thanksgiving dinner tablescape in an inviting dining room, integrating all ten referenced products into one coherent scene set for guests about to arrive. Keep each product exactly faithful to its reference: precise shape, color, materials, branding, labels, proportions, and details — no substitutions, omissions, or invented items. Arrange them naturally by function — table items on the linen-dressed table, serving and kitchen pieces staged logically nearby, decorative pieces as seasonal accents — every product clearly visible and correctly scaled relative to the others. Shoot from a slightly high three-quarter viewpoint with moderate depth of field so all items stay sharp. Use warm golden-hour window light mixed with soft candlelight, autumnal color palette, subtle fall garland and pumpkins as background context only. Premium lifestyle catalog photography, natural shadows, lifelike textures.
